Binds the governed Phase 1 setup runbook to the governed Phase 2 migration boundary so that environment setup, migration equivalence, and cutover execution remain one enforceable chain.

Defines the binding between cross-system proof validation rules (RULE‑014) and their concrete implementation within the AfriTech platform. Ensures that all proof verification logic is executed through governed, auditable components.

Declares the non-runtime executable binding surface for AfriTech Constitution v1.0. This binding makes the doctrine validateable through CI while preserving the boundary that Constitution v1.0 is not active runtime authority.
Binds governed data decentralization to ADR-0020, INV-DATA-001, RULE-040, runtime-style guards, and CI validation.

Binds ADR-0048 and RULE-068 to NovaPay mobile-money routing, secure callback handling, persistence, configuration, tests, and operator documentation.
Binds the NovaTech Platform Constitution and ADR-0049 to its human standards, machine contract, runtime vocabulary, JSON Schemas, CI validator, and tests.
Binds ADR-0050 and RULE-070 to runtime schema validation, version negotiation, schema publication, lineage, federation compatibility, SDKs, metrics, portal, and their tests.
